symptom: my LED is ON when the script starts and goes dark when I call on(). The breakout is one of those relay-style active-low modules.

files.led.py:
from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
led = LED(17)
while True:
    led.on()
    sleep(0.5)
    led.off()
    sleep(0.5)

gold.diagnosis: The module is active-low: the pin must go LOW to switch the LED on. Use LED(17, active_state=False) or invert the logic.
